description: pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs: NoRevocation derives Clone, Copy, Debug, Default but not PartialEq, Eq, or Hash. As a ZST with no fields, all three are trivially derivable. Missing these prevents NoRevocation from being used as a HashMap key, stored in a HashSet, or compared in tests. Idiomatic Rust ZST types should derive the full set of value-equality traits when they have no data to compare.
title: NoRevocation missing PartialEq, Eq, Hash derives
